verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs say its features can run directly on top of the customer's own data warehouse through Warehouse Native, with no ETL. That satisfies the story's in-product warehouse-query option, and the llms.txt probe lists Warehouse Native as a documented area. Missing for 10: details on supported warehouses and how tables are queried, any evidence of continuous event export to a warehouse, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync events between the platform and my own data warehouse (query warehouse tables in-product or export events continuously to it)

citations.quote: You can use any of these features on top of your own data warehouse through Warehouse Native with no extract, transform, and load (ETL).
